_comment: Tool schemas for the Free Business Registration inbound agent (Ellie). Every url points at the n8n webhook for this client. Retell field names shift between versions - verify against current Retell docs before importing.

tools.name: start_registration
tools.description: The most valuable call this business takes. A caller wants to register a UK limited company. Capture everything needed to file and get it to the formations team the same working day. Use this even if the caller has not settled on a company name yet - log the rest and set name_status to pending, so the lead is never lost. Read the company name spelling, email and phone number back before calling this.

full_name.description: Caller's full name, as it will appear on the incorporation

phone.description: Best contact number, read back and confirmed

email.description: Email for the incorporation documents, read back and confirmed

company_name.description: First-choice company name, spelling confirmed with the caller

company_name_alt.description: Second-choice name if the first is unavailable at Companies House

name_status.description: Whether the caller has settled on a name

business_activity.description: What the business will actually do, in the caller's own words - the team map this to a SIC code

uk_resident.description: Whether the caller is UK resident. Non-residents can register but need a human to walk through address and banking

other_officers.description: Any additional directors or shareholders the caller mentioned, and roughly how shares are to be split if they volunteered it

wants_bank_account.description: True if the caller wants the free partner business bank account application included

wants_phone_number.description: True if the caller wants the free UK business phone number

wants_website.description: True if the caller wants the free AI-built one-page website

summary.description: Anything else the formations team should know before they file or ring back

tools.name: log_service_interest
tools.description: The caller has shown genuine interest in a paid service from the shop - a website, branding, social media, SEO, appointment setting or a starter pack. Never take payment or card details on the call; this hands a warm, qualified buyer to the sales team with the reason they need it. Only call this when the caller has given a real reason for the service, not because a service was mentioned.

phone.description: Best contact number, read back and confirmed

email.description: Email for the secure order link

company_name.description: Their business name, if they have one yet

service.description: The exact shop item discussed. Never invent a service that is not on this list.

why_they_need_it.description: The problem in the caller's own words - this is what the sales team open on. Do not paraphrase into marketing language.

price_reaction.description: How they responded when the price was said out loud

temperature.description: How ready they are to buy

is_new_registration.description: True if this came off the back of a company registration started on the same call

summary.description: Anything else the sales team need before they ring

tools.name: book_callback
tools.description: Book a specific time for the UK team to ring the caller back. Use for non-UK residents, anyone needing legal, tax or structure advice, callers who want to think about it, and anyone who asks to speak to a person. Offer two specific times rather than asking open-endedly, read the agreed time back, and only confirm once this returns success.

phone.description: Number to ring, read back and confirmed

datetime.description: Agreed date and time in ISO 8601, Europe/London

summary.description: What the caller wants covered, so the team open on it rather than starting cold

tools.name: check_registration_status
tools.description: An existing customer is chasing their incorporation, certificate, company number or documents. Never invent or guess a status, never say an application has been approved or filed, and never give a timescale you were not given. Log the chase, note how they sound, and tell them when someone will come back.

contact_name.description: Full name the application was made under

phone.description: Contact number, read back and confirmed

email.description: Email used on the application, if given

company_name.description: Company name they registered or applied for

applied_when.description: Roughly when they applied or last heard anything

sentiment.description: How the caller sounds - drives how fast someone rings back

summary.description: Exactly what they are asking about

tools.name: support_request
tools.description: An existing customer needs help with something already set up: the partner business bank account application, their free UK phone number, the AI website builder or their hosted site, or their digital company documents. Never state whether a bank application has been approved or declined and never promise a banking timescale - the partner bank owns that decision.

phone.description: Contact number, read back and confirmed

urgency.description: How fast someone needs to respond

summary.description: What they need, in enough detail that the team can fix it without ringing twice

tools.name: escalate_to_human
tools.description: Hand off to a person now. Use for a complaint, an angry or distressed caller, anyone threatening to leave or go elsewhere, anything legal, any refund or money dispute, and any suspected fraud or identity concern. Do not attempt to resolve, defend the company, explain policy, or offer anything - escalate early rather than late.

phone.description: Callback number, read back and confirmed

company_name.description: Their company, if they have one with us

urgency.description: How fast someone must ring back

summary.description: What happened, in the caller's own words where possible

tools.name: take_message
tools.description: Catch-all for anything that does not fit the other tools - suppliers, partnership enquiries, press, recruitment, wrong numbers worth logging. Always prefer a specific tool where one applies: someone registering a company is always start_registration, never this.

phone.description: Callback number, read back and confirmed

caller_type.description: What kind of caller this is
